in-dolabella-sea-hare.title: Sea Hare (Dolabella)
in-dolabella-sea-hare.summary: A large sea slug that grazes hair algae. Useful in algae-heavy tanks, but sensitive to water changes and it can release ink.
rows: 20 gal or larger (more for big ones)
Herbivore: hair algae; offer nori or other algae when tank algae runs out
notes: Drip-acclimate slowly: it is sensitive to changes in salinity and pH.
warn: Like all sea hares, it squirts purple ink when disturbed.

in-nudibranch-assorted.title: Nudibranch (assorted)
in-nudibranch-assorted.summary: Colorful sea slugs. Most species eat only one kind of food (a certain sponge, coral, algae or pest), so long-term success depends on knowing what yours eats.
rows: Varies by species and is often very specialized
Moderate to expert, depending on species
notes: Ask which species you are getting and confirm its food is available.
warn: Some nudibranchs release toxins if they die or are stressed; keep activated carbon on hand.
